node.statement: Because 0<r<s, choose a standard smooth cutoff chi:B_R(0)->[0,1] with chi=1 on B_r(0) and supp(chi) compactly contained in B_s(0). Compact containment gives epsilon>0 such that chi(y)=0 whenever s-epsilon<||y||<s; in particular chi vanishes on a neighbourhood of the patch boundary partial B_s, not on a neighbourhood of the boundary of its own support.
